stem: Which detail from paragraphs 2 and 3 best supports the key idea that neglecting to cite sources is wrong?

options.label: A
options.text: Citing sources is the proper thing to do because it credits others for their ideas.

options.label: B
options.text: It is dishonest to take the work of others and try to pass it off as our own.

options.label: C
options.text: Citing sources is a common practice when using something from another writer.

options.label: D
options.text: It is difficult to ask permission from most writers whose ideas we use.
